rationale: Lyc. ⲣ̄-ⲧⲱⲕ 'do-firmness, fortify.' Verbal compound formed from ⲧⲱⲕ 'be firm, fast, established' (cf. accumulated ⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧ⸗ 'stand fast,' ⲡⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϩ 'standing-fast'). Used here of the catechumen-gathering as host strengthening/fortifying the indwelling church.
Greek loanword μάχη 'battle, struggle' with Lyc. orthographic adaptation (-ⲍⲥ̄ ending = pluralized possessive ⲙⲁⲭⲏ-ⲥ̄ 'her battles'). Standard Coptic register for ecclesiastical/ascetic struggles.

Greek loanword ὑποδοχεύς 'one who receives, host.' Lyc. ⲍ-onset for spiritus + dialectal ⲗ for δ. Cosmological designation of the Land of Light as final eschatological receiver of the cosmic luminaries.

Lyc. possessive substantive form, parallel to ⲡⲱⲓ̈ 'mine,' ⲡⲱⲕ 'yours.' The prosthetic ⲡⲧ- may be a Lyc. dialectal article-cluster or scribal feature. Translates 'that which belongs to them.' Confidence moderate; alternative reading as ⲡⲧⲟⲟⲩ 'the mountain' cannot be ruled out.
Tentative reading as plural of ⲡⲟⲟⲩ 'today/day.' Used in the construction ⲍⲛ̄ ⲟⲩⲧⲱⲧ ⲙ̄ⲡⲟⲟⲩⲉ 'in an agreement of the days' = 'in fixed/settled time.' Confidence low; flagged for parallels.

Verbal compound ⲣ̄- ('become, act as') + ⲣⲟ ('gate, mouth'). Distinct from homograph ⲣ̄-ⲣ̄ⲣⲟ 'reign, be king' (in glossary). Disambiguated by qualitative agreement (ⲉϥⲟⲩⲏⲛ 'open' agrees with masc. ⲣⲟ 'gate' in line 17).
